# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is described as a pale maiden with a spiritual appearance. Despite her ethereal look, she possesses a lively nature full of mischief and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, Priscilla Grant is known for a lively disposition. She is constantly full of fun, mischief, and a penchant for playing pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- full to the brim of mischief and pranks and fun  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
